name: Project Browser Extra Recipes
description: Exposes extra_* recipes to Project Browser.
project_description: Project Browser Extra Recipes adds a single Project Browser source plugin (id 'extra_recipes', class Drupal\extra_project_browser\Plugin\ProjectBrowserSource\ExtraRecipes) that surfaces the site's own recipes whose directory name starts with 'extra_' inside core's Project Browser UI. It performs no remote fetch: on each getProjects() call it scans local disk with a Symfony Finder (depth 1, name recipe.yml) across the core Recipes source's configured recipes path and the project-root ../recipes directory, keeps only directories prefixed 'extra_', and drops a hardcoded exclusion list (extra_view_modes, extra_paragraphs). For each recipe it reads the title/description from recipe.yml and the Composer package name plus homepage from an adjacent composer.json (defaulting to 'extra/unknown' when absent), marks every entry isCompatible, and returns them as ProjectType::Recipe results sorted case-insensitively by title, with in-memory search/machine_name filtering and array_chunk paging. Results are cached in the cache.project_browser bin keyed by the plugin id. A hook_install auto-enables the 'extra_recipes' source in project_browser.admin_settings (enabled_sources); hook_uninstall removes it. The module ships no routes, controllers, permissions, forms, config objects, config schema, entities, services or Drush commands, and defines no plugin type of its own — it implements Project Browser's existing ProjectBrowserSource plugin type.
